name: Jangmo-o
description: The Scaly Pokémon. It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

abilities.name: Antibalas
abilities.description: Este Pokémon es inmune a daño de movimientos con Bala, Balón, Bola, Bomba o Cañón, en su nombre.

abilities.name: Insonorizar
abilities.description: Este Pokémon es inmune a movimientos relacionados con sonido.

abilities.name: Funda
abilities.description: Este Pokémon no recibe daño de movimientos ni fenómenos relacionados con el clima, como Granizo, Meteorobola, etc.
